nodes.label: edge_ssh_image artifact
nodes.rationale: SSH-enabled Ubuntu 22.04 container on CHI@Edge: image ghcr.io/chameleoncloud/edge_ssh_image:latest, exposed port 22, RSA key injection into authorized_keys, floating IP association. Uses the functional python-chi style (create_lease/create_container), unlike the other artifacts' object-oriented style; count=2 reserves two devices but only one is used — preserved verbatim.
